// @path: src/lib/ops/stripeLinks.ts
// The shape the PR3 widening permits, and the whole of it. Two booleans in, a
// string out. No network call, no secret key, no database, and nothing here
// writes anything: owner decision D6 makes the billing screen read-only with a
// link out to Stripe, which is where the truth lives.
//
// The mode segment sits before the page and is omitted entirely for live mode,
// verified against Stripe's own deep-link documentation rather than written
// from memory.
import { stripeConfigured, stripeLiveMode } from "@/lib/stripeMode";

const ORIGIN = "https://dashboard.stripe.com";
const SHAPE = /^[A-Za-z0-9_]{3,255}$/;

export function currentMode() {
  if (!stripeConfigured()) return null;
  return stripeLiveMode() ? "live" : "test";
}

export function customerLink(mode, id) {
  if (!SHAPE.test(id)) return null;
  return `${ORIGIN}${mode === "test" ? "/test" : ""}/customers/${id}`;
}
